title: 38_143685_box_Incident_Summaries_101-172
doc_notes: This document is a collection of incident summaries regarding unidentified flying objects and aerial phenomena, containing several firsthand reports of close-range encounters. / This document contains a series of incident summaries regarding unidentified flying objects, including reports from military personnel and civilians.

encounters.summary: Leland Sammons observed a funnel-shaped object hovering near his house, which wobbled, emitted fire, and showered sparks before departing rapidly.
encounters.entity_behavior: hovered, wobbled, belched fire, showered sparks
encounters.quote: The thing was about 4' long, shaped something like a funnel.

encounters.summary: Lt. Meyers observed a silver, half-moon shaped flying wing aircraft that performed rapid maneuvers and disappeared.
encounters.quote: The object appeared to be a flying wing aircraft, its shape resembled a half moon.

encounters.summary: Lt. Col. Robert B. Hughes observed a silver, parachute-like object with a canister suspended by a cable.
encounters.entity_appearance: silver, parachute-like top, dark cable, silver canister
encounters.entity_behavior: flew away on a horizontal plane
encounters.quote: Top part of the object approximately eight feet in diameter, silver in color, had the appearance of a parachute.

encounters.summary: Col. W. F. Siegmund observed a creature resembling a huge fowl that was bigger than an airplane.
encounters.entity_appearance: huge fowl, bigger than an airplane
encounters.quote: Resembled a huge fowl and not a type of aircraft

encounters.summary: Lt Kokolonis observed 5 silvery-gold disc-shaped objects flying in a stepped-up formation at high speed.
encounters.quote: Objects maintained smooth track thru sky

encounters.summary: M/Sgt Ernest Davis, Jr. observed 2 shiny brass round objects flying a straight course.
encounters.location_name: 6 miles due east of Monroe, Michigan
encounters.quote: Appeared to be four feet in diameter

encounters.summary: Maj Elmer H. Hammer, Jr. observed 12 elliptical yellowish-white objects in a tight diamond formation.
Mrs. Wilda Zittak observed 2 silver, cigar-shaped objects through binoculars that bobbed up and down.
encounters.quote: looked like something going through air currents

encounters.summary: Pilot Clarence Shipe Chiles and Co-Pilot John B. Whitted observed a cigar-shaped craft with two rows of windows and a blue glow underneath.
encounters.entity_appearance: cigar-shaped, two rows of windows, blue glow underneath, shooting flame from rear
encounters.quote: two rows of windows, which indicated an upper and lower deck

encounters.summary: 1st Lt Dominick J. Caramia and Thomas B. Carpenter observed approximately 20 grayish-black spheroid or disc-shaped objects.
encounters.entity_behavior: jockeyed back and forth in shotgun blast pattern
encounters.quote: jockeyed back and forth in the group formation

encounters.summary: Two children observed a dull gray, round object land in their backyard, spin, whistle, and maneuver around wires.
encounters.entity_behavior: landed, spun, whistled, maneuvered around wires
encounters.quote: settled to the ground gently - much as a balloon

encounters.summary: Mr. and Mrs. Vernon Swigert observed a white, cymbal-shaped object that shimmered and appeared to spin.
encounters.quote: shaped like a cymbal with smooth surfaces
